test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Nine persons – Ajay, Rahul, Beena, Ajit, Komal, Pawan, Ankit, Aditya and Kaushal – are sitting in a straight line, facing north, but not necessarily in the same order. Rahul is fourth to the right of Beena. Komal is second to the left of Aditya and fourth to the right of Ajay, who is fifth to the left of Ajit. Ajay is NOT an immediate neighbour of Beena. Aditya is sitting on the extreme right end. Pawan is NOT an immediate neighbour of Rahul

Who are the immediate neighbours of Rahul?
solution:
** Given: **Nine persons – Ajay, Rahul, Beena, Ajit, Komal, Pawan, Ankit, Aditya and Kaushal are sitting in a straight line.

**1) Rahul** is sitting at **fourth **to the **right of Beena**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e107753b7f840f8393bb311ac2d40971ae97651fd837d207bbd7a9e7785ae60.png] 

**2) **Komal is **second **to the **left **of **Aditya **and **fourth **to the **right **of **Ajay**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/661d6178dc081d1b8be4ea6a342cb717b504702f3ea1b54b58ba5748b51ee787.png] 

**3) Ajay** is sitting at the **fifth position **to the** left of Ajit**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b8416421f365e7e83b47673ced083f7f15d001ea5b09e78ab47abf03de4e7b9.png] 

**4) Ajay** is** not an immediate neighbor** of **Beena**. 

**5) Pawan** is **not an immediate neighbor** of **Rahul**.

6) On the **extreme right** end, the person sitting is** Aditya**.

Combining the above tables and keeping in mind the above mentioned 3 points, we obtain their **pattern of sitting**:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd840f5e0800de6ca3457b0eec510f64367019b4eead382b473bdc5317a9c0f4.png] 

 
• 
 
Thus, only two spaces are left that are immediate neighbors to Rahul. After fulfilling all the points given in the questions above, only Kaushal and Ankit are left.

 
 
• 
 
The **final sitting arrangement** of these nine people is:

 
 
• 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75f98b4590530ac684bcf2fde6790c9d34c507dcb908b24b86dbc6a1a416e703.png] 

 

So, the immediate neighbors of Rahul are Kaushal and Ankit.

Hence, the correct answer is: **"Option (2)"**.​
